moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio e-sine, written here): Target moves 0 → 100 % in 2000 ms sine.inOut and back to 0 by 4000 ms (yoyo), looping. Site rule: floating loops and breathing, 2–4 s cycles; dreamy and calm. Site demo: 1200 ms across 114 px beside the curve graph and a 12-frame spacing ruler (guides, not ported). Params: half: nửa chu kỳ (2 s) · amount · repeat (yoyo).
